title: Ship once per milestone
summary: MyAPES Account updates now ship once per milestone: all the work is finished first, then it is merged, released and deployed together.
changes: Updates are grouped by milestone and reach the live site together, in one release.
A new contributing guide explains how work ships.
Developer and agent guides now describe one merge, one release and one deploy per milestone.
version_rationale: Patch: process and documentation changes only, with no change to application behaviour.
known_limitations: None. The app itself is unchanged.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Nothing in the app depends on this release.
provenance: Milestone Ship once per milestone: issues #625, #627, #628 and #629, shipped by issue #630 in pull request #633.
